   - A new variable `encounteredConfigTypes` of type `Collection<String>` (specifically a `HashSet`) was added to track the configuration types that have already been processed.
   - The loop that processes each service configuration type was modified to include a check using `encounteredConfigTypes.add(serviceConfigType)`. This ensures that a configuration type is only added to the `blueprintConfigRequest` once.
   - The previous logic that directly processed configuration types, including handling for `cluster-env`, has been nested within the new check to prevent duplicate processing.

### Relationships Between Modifications:
The modifications introduced a mechanism to prevent the duplication of configuration types when deploying blueprints. The original logic was modified to incorporate a temporary check that uses the newly added `encounteredConfigTypes` variable, effectively ensuring that each configuration type is processed only once. This change directly addresses the bug identified as AMBARI-8867 and is intended as a temporary fix for a broader issue referenced as BUG-28939, indicating that further refinement will occur as part of another task (BUG-29145).
